title: Zilla Panchayat may acquire, hold and dispose of property, etc

versions.Latest:
164. Zilla Panchayat may acquire, hold and dispose of property, etc.—

—   The power 
of every Zilla Panchayat to acquire, hold and dispose of property both movable and 
immovable whether within or without the limits of the area over which it has authority, to 
lease, sell or otherwise transfer any movable or immovable property which may have 
become vested in or been acquired by it, and to contract and to do all other things 
necessary for the purposes of this Act, which shall be subject to the rules made by the 
Government in this behalf: 
Provided that no lease of immovable property for a term exceeding five years and no 
sale or other transfer of any such property shall be valid unless such lease, sale or other 
transfer shall have been made with the previous sanction of the Government.
